title: The new-version check can stop for a long time after the phone clock goes back
what: The app asks GitHub for a new version only when the last answer is more than 6 hours old. If the phone clock was ahead and is then set back, the last answer looks to be from the future, so the app does not ask again until the clock passes that time. The What's new check next to it already handles this case.
expected: A saved answer dated in the future is treated as old, and the app asks again.
who: members who installed from GitHub and whose phone clock was wrong
fix_line: Ask again when the saved answer's time is later than now

title: Help and feedback sends more than the privacy notice says
what: With each help question the phone also sends its push address (kept so the team's reply can pop up), the gym's member key, and how its gym pop-up channel is set. The privacy notice's list for Help and feedback names the message, app version, phone model, screen, gym code, install number and coded internet address, but not these.
expected: The notice names everything the help box receives, or the phone stops sending what the notice does not name.
who: every member who sends a help question
fix_line: Add the push address and gym key to the privacy notice's help list
